name: Semantic Persistence Registry
purpose: Define bounded semantic persistence classes describing when meaning remains partially recoverable under projection transformations.

persistence_classes.definition: Meaning that remains stable within a local projection neighborhood.
Meaning that can be partially reconstructed through source-relation trace metadata.
Semantic structures whose meaning is tied to the preservation of specific projection tensions.
Meaning that degrades rapidly under projection deformation or flattening.
Semantic artifacts that have lost all recoverable link to the source relation.

metrics.definition: Measures the fraction of interpretive metadata preserved after projection transformation.
Evaluates whether the semantic structure respects projection-domain constraints.
Quantifies the clustering of stable interpretations within a semantic neighborhood.
Measures the explicitness of documented semantic losses or abstractions.

governance_rules.rule: High semantic persistence scores do not imply truth or ontology identity.
Persistence analysis must explicitly declare projection-loss visibility.

forbidden_claims: Semantic persistence proves that a term is 'true'.
High stability density derives physical semantic fields.
Meaning recovery justifies the assumption of detached observer assignation.
